text:
An air pistol fires a pellet forwards.
What is the motion of the air pistol?
A
The air pistol moves backwards with speed greater than the pellet.
B
The air pistol moves backwards with speed less than the pellet.
C
The air pistol moves forward with speed greater than the pellet.
D
The air pistol moves forward with speed less than the pellet.

options.label: A
options.text: The air pistol moves backwards with speed greater than the pellet.

options.label: B
options.text: The air pistol moves backwards with speed less than the pellet.

options.label: C
options.text: The air pistol moves forward with speed greater than the pellet.

options.label: D
options.text: The air pistol moves forward with speed less than the pellet.
